sources: the reads themselves, via step 2's run_sample_mapping.csv

amplicon.paper_statement: NOT CHECKED - no one has read this paper's Methods. Confirm the primer pair and set status to 'verified' before relying on this for anything but denoising.
amplicon.primer_evidence: probed 6 runs: forward primer in 98% of reads, reverse in 99%

insert_length_primer_free.method: R1 vs revcomp(R2) overlap over 4405 pairs from 6 runs (>=80% identity in the overlap)

amplicon.max_trunc_len_reason: read length; no 3' read-through to avoid
amplicon.trunc_len_basis: RAW read bases. dada2::fastqPairedFilter removes trimLeft first and then truncates to truncLen - trimLeft, keeping only reads at least truncLen long, so a read contributes bases trimLeft+1 .. truncLen.
amplicon.read_through: 0.1% of probed reads reached revcomp of the reverse primer

sample_identity.note: Technical controls come from step 2's per-sample is_technical_control. Add alias prefixes here only if step 2 missed a control that the paper names as one.
